When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change.  Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one. Lane departure warning - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.  With lane departure warning, your vehicle lets you know when you've unintentionally left your lane.  Lane departure warning is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.Technology and Telematics Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicles private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot. Voice activated integrated navigation system - A to B made easy! The interior prioritizes both driver comfort and passenger convenience. Power-adjustable front seats with sport trim ensure you find your ideal driving position, while the tilt and telescoping steering wheel accommodates drivers of all sizes. Thoughtful touches like the leather shift knob, illuminated entry, and overhead console create an environment that feels purposeful and well-appointed. The split folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility for larger items or additional passengers.  Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. NissanConnect with Apple CarPlay puts navigation, music, and communications within reach through intuitive controls. The steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you adjust volume and switch tracks without taking your hands off the steering wheel. SiriusXM radio access broadens your entertainment options, while the trip computer provides useful vehicle information at a glance.  Safety features throughout this Altima work quietly to protect you and your passengers. Blind Spot Warning alerts you to vehicles in your peripheral vision, while Rear Parking Sensors help prevent minor accidents during reversing. The comprehensive airbag system, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control form a protective layer that responds to challenging driving situations. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power in various conditions.  Exterior details reflect the SR's sporty character. The 19-inch sport alloy wheels convey an athletic stance, while auto high-beam headlights and speed-sensitive wipers enhance visibility in changing weather. Body-color bumpers and power door mirrors finished in color-matching paint create seamless styling integration.  With 54,398 miles, this 2024 Altima remains well within its operational prime and backed by remaining factory coverage. The SR trim level strikes the right balance between feature availability and value, offering everything you need for daily driving without unnecessary extras.
